docs.title: NoraSign Documentation
docs.text:
NoraSign is a production-grade digital signature and software release verification utility designed for IF4020 Kriptografi Semester 1 Tahun 2026/2027 at Institut Teknologi Bandung.

Modeled after the principles of Sigstore Cosign blob signing, NoraSign enables software release pipelines to bind build artifacts to canonical cryptographic manifests, sign them across multiple asymmetric algorithms, and verify provenance in offline or air-gapped CI/CD environments.

docs.title: Authors
docs.text:
• Brian A. Hadian (NIM 13523048)
  • Andrew Isra Saputra DB (NIM 13523110)

docs.title: High-Level Workflow
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    subgraph Build ["Build Pipeline"]
        Art["Release Artifact<br/>(ZIP / TAR / BIN)"]
        Hash["Compute SHA-256"]
        Art --> Hash
        Hash --> Manifest["Generate Canonical Manifest<br/>(minisign-manifest/v1)"]
        PrivKey["Private Key (PKCS#8 PEM)"] --> Sign["Sign Manifest M"]
        Manifest --> Sign
        Sign --> Bundle["Generate Bundle JSON<br/>(minisign-bundle/v1)"]
    end

    subgraph Verify ["Verification Gate"]
        Bundle --> Verifier["8-Step Verification Pipeline"]
        Trust["Trust Store JSON"] --> Verifier
        Verifier --> Result{"Status"}
        Result -->|OK (Exit 0)| Deploy["Deploy Release"]
        Result -->|Reject (Exit 1/2)| Halt["Halt Pipeline"]
    end

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
1. Multi-Algorithm Asymmetric Cryptography:
  2. rsa-pss-sha256: RSA 3072-bit, RSASSA-PSS, MGF1-SHA-256, 32-byte salt, 384-byte signature.
  3. ecdsa-p256-sha256: NIST P-256 (secp256r1), SHA-256, raw 64-byte r || s big-endian encoding.

  4. ed25519: PureEdDSA (RFC 8032), direct manifest signing, 64-byte signature.

  5. Tamper-Proof Canonical Manifest:

  6. UTF-8 without BOM, whitespace-free serialization.
  7. Strict field sequencing and recursive duplicate field rejection.

  8. Exact size and schema bounds.

  9. Secure Base64 Bundling:

  10. RFC 4648 compliance with strict padding validation and whitespace prohibition.

  11. Segregated private key boundary (private keys never serialized into bundles).

  12. Containerized CI/CD Integration:

  13. Zero runtime network dependency (--network none).
  14. Supports arbitrary runner UID/GID via --user.
  15. Native integration with GitHub Actions and GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io).

docs.title: Internal API: Release Bundle (norasign.bundle)
docs.text: The norasign.bundle module provides utilities for packaging canonical manifests and digital signatures into release bundles.

docs.title: create_bundle(manifest_bytes: bytes, signature_bytes: bytes) -> Dict[str, str]
docs.text: Creates a bundle dictionary containing: - schema: "minisign-bundle/v1" - manifest_b64: RFC 4648 standard Base64 string of raw manifest bytes. - signature_b64: RFC 4648 standard Base64 string of raw signature bytes.

docs.title: serialize_bundle(bundle: Dict[str, Any], indent: int = 2) -> bytes
docs.text: Serializes bundle into JSON bytes. - Validates bundle size $\le 65536$ bytes (64 KiB).

docs.title: parse_and_validate_bundle(raw_bytes: bytes) -> Tuple[bytes, bytes, Dict[str, Any]]
docs.text: Parses and validates bundle bytes: - Checks size $\le 64$ KiB. - Prohibits UTF-8 BOM. - Detects duplicate JSON keys. - Prohibits extra or unknown fields. - Validates RFC 4648 Base64 strictly. - Returns (manifest_bytes, signature_bytes, bundle_dict).

docs.title: validate_rfc4648_base64(b64_str: str) -> bytes
docs.text: Validates that a string conforms strictly to RFC 4648 Base64: - Rejects whitespace (newlines, spaces, tabs). - Rejects URL-safe characters (-, _). - Verifies canonical padding (=). - Performs round-trip comparison: b64encode(b64decode(s)) == s.

docs.title: Internal API: Cryptographic Engine (norasign.crypto)
docs.text: The norasign.crypto package provides cryptographic operations conforming to the assignment specification.

docs.title: Module Structure
docs.text:
norasign.crypto/
├── __init__.py        # High-level dispatcher (sign_message, verify_message_signature)
├── keys.py            # Keypair generation, PEM/DER encoding, fingerprint calculation
├── rsa_pss.py         # RSASSA-PSS implementation (3072-bit, 32-byte salt)
├── ecdsa_p256.py      # ECDSA P-256 implementation (raw r || s conversion)
└── ed25519.py         # Ed25519 implementation (RFC 8032 PureEdDSA)

docs.title: generate_keypair(algorithm: str)
docs.text: Generates an asymmetric keypair conforming to the algorithm profile. - Parameters: algorithm (str): one of rsa-pss-sha256, ecdsa-p256-sha256, ed25519. - Returns: Tuple[PrivateKey, PublicKey].

docs.title: calculate_keyid(public_key)
docs.text: Calculates the 64-character lowercase hexadecimal fingerprint of a public key: $$\text{keyid} = \text{hex_lower}(\text{SHA-256}(\text{DER_SPKI}))$$ - Parameters: public_key: RSAPublicKey, EllipticCurvePublicKey, or Ed25519PublicKey. - Returns: str: 64 hex characters.

docs.title: save_keypair_files(algorithm: str, out_prefix: str, overwrite: bool = False)
docs.text: Generates a keypair and saves <out_prefix>.key.pem (mode 0600) and <out_prefix>.pub.pem. - Returns: Tuple[str, str, str]: (private_key_path, public_key_path, keyid).

docs.title: norasign.crypto.sign_message
docs.text:
sign_message(private_key, algorithm: str, message: bytes) -> bytes
Signs arbitrary raw message bytes using the designated profile. - Returns raw signature bytes: - 384 bytes for rsa-pss-sha256. - 64 bytes (r || s) for ecdsa-p256-sha256. - 64 bytes for ed25519.

docs.title: norasign.crypto.verify_message_signature
docs.text:
verify_message_signature(public_key, algorithm: str, message: bytes, signature: bytes) -> bool
Verifies raw signature bytes over message bytes. - Returns True if signature is valid. - Returns False on signature mismatch, incorrect signature length, or out-of-domain parameters.

docs.title: Internal API: Release Manifest (norasign.manifest)
docs.text: The norasign.manifest module handles canonical manifest creation, strict parsing, duplicate field detection, and canonical validation.

docs.title: build_manifest(artifact_path: str, package: str, version: str, algorithm: str, keyid: str) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bytes]
docs.text: Constructs an in-memory dictionary and canonical UTF-8 byte string $M$ from an artifact file. - Reads artifact file without normalization. - Computes SHA-256 and byte length. - Validates all fields against Table 2.3 regex patterns. - Returns (manifest_dict, canonical_bytes).

docs.title: serialize_manifest(manifest: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes
docs.text: Serializes a manifest dictionary into canonical JSON bytes. - Enforces field sequence: schema, package, version, algorithm, keyid, artifact. - Enforces artifact sequence: name, size, sha256. - Strips whitespace (separators=(',', ':')). - Checks maximum size $\le 16384$ bytes.

docs.title: parse_and_validate_manifest(raw_bytes: bytes, enforce_canonical: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]
docs.text: Strictly parses and verifies a manifest: - Detects duplicate keys during parsing via strict_json_pairs_hook. - Validates types, ranges, non-null values, and regex patterns. - If enforce_canonical is enabled, performs byte-for-byte comparison with reconstructed canonical serialization.

docs.title: strict_json_pairs_hook(pairs)
docs.text: Hook for json.loads that detects duplicate field names at any object nesting level. - Raises ValueError upon detecting duplicate keys.

docs.title: CLI Command Reference
docs.text: NoraSign provides a command-line interface conforming strictly to Table 2.7 of the IF4020 specification.

docs.title: Global Options
docs.text:
• --help, -h: Show usage instructions.
  • --version, -v: Display application version.
norasign --version
norasign --help

docs.title: 1. Key Generation (keygen)
docs.text:
Generates a cryptographic keypair matching the specified profile.

norasign keygen --algorithm <profile> --out <prefix> [--force]

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Option Required Description --algorithm Yes Target algorithm profile: rsa-pss-sha256, ecdsa-p256-sha256, or ed25519. --out Yes Output prefix path. Produces <prefix>.key.pem and <prefix>.pub.pem. --force, -f No Allow overwriting existing private key file.

docs.title: Output
docs.text:
• <prefix>.key.pem: PKCS#8 unencrypted PEM format (PRIVATE KEY), file permissions 0600.
  • <prefix>.pub.pem: SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI) PEM format (PUBLIC KEY).
  • Prints the 64-character lowercase hex public key fingerprint (keyid) to stdout.

docs.title: 2. Sign Release Artifact (sign)
docs.text:
Generates a release manifest and creates a digital signature bundle.

norasign sign --file <path> --package <name> --version <version> --key <private.pem> --out <bundle.json>

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Option Required Description --file Yes Path to the release artifact (binary, archive, or document). --package Yes Package identifier matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$. --version Yes Release version string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,63}$. --key Yes Path to the signer's private key in PKCS#8 PEM format. --out Yes Output file path for the generated bundle JSON.

docs.title: Exit Codes
docs.text:
• 0: Signing succeeded and bundle was written.
  • 2: Input or I/O error (unreadable file, invalid private key, missing parameters).

docs.title: 3. Verify Release (verify)
docs.text:
Verifies an artifact file against a signed bundle and trusted public keys.

norasign verify --file <path> --bundle <bundle.json> --trust-store <trust.json> --package <name> --version <version> [--json]

docs.title: Parameters
docs.text: Option Required Description --file Yes Path to the candidate artifact file. --bundle Yes Path to the signature bundle JSON. --trust-store Yes Path to the trust store JSON containing authorized keys. --package Yes Expected package name. --version Yes Expected release version. --json No Emit machine-readable single-line JSON result to stdout.

docs.title: Exit Codes
docs.text:
• 0: Verification succeeded (OK).
  • 1: Verification rejected (FORMAT_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_ALGORITHM, KEY_NOT_TRUSTED, INVALID_SIGNATURE, METADATA_MISMATCH, ARTIFACT_MISMATCH).
  • 2: Input, environment, or I/O error (INPUT_ERROR).

docs.title: Add Key Authorization
docs.text: norasign trust add --key <public.pem> --package <name> --store <trust.json>

docs.title: List Trusted Keys
docs.text: norasign trust list --store <trust.json>

docs.title: Remove Key Authorization
docs.text: norasign trust remove --keyid <fingerprint> --store <trust.json>

docs.title: Container Distribution & CI/CD Guide
docs.text: NoraSign is distributed as a lightweight container image for linux/amd64 adhering to the container execution contract in Table 2.13.

docs.title: Container Image Details
docs.text:
• Public Registry: ghcr.io/brianhadianstei23/norasign
  • Release Tag: 1.0.0
  • Digest Pinning: Recommended for immutability and supply-chain integrity: 
    docker pull ghcr.io/brianhadianstei23/norasign:1.0.0

docs.title: Container Execution Model
docs.text: The container image directly invokes the norasign CLI. No runtime compilers or network connectivity are needed.

docs.title: Running with Zero Network Access (--network none)
docs.text:
All dependencies (such as Python and cryptography) are bundled within the container image:

docker run --rm --network none \
    --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
    ghcr.io/brianhadianstei23/norasign:1.0.0 --version

docs.title: File Mount Contract
docs.text:
• Artifact input directory mounted as read-only (:ro).
  • Output bundle directory mounted read-write (/output).
  • Signer private key mounted as a read-only file (/run/signing.key.pem:ro).
docker run --rm --network none \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -v "$PWD/dist:/input:ro" \
  -v "$PWD/out:/output" \
  -v "$SIGNING_KEY_FILE:/run/signing.key.pem:ro" \
  ghcr.io/brianhadianstei23/norasign:1.0.0 sign \
  --file /input/contoh-app.zip \
  --package contoh-app \
  --version 1.0.0 \
  --key /run/signing.key.pem \
  --out /output/release.bundle.json

docs.title: Cryptographic Profiles Specification
docs.text: NoraSign supports three asymmetric digital signature algorithm profiles conforming to Table 2.1 of the IF4020 specification.

docs.title: Profile Summary
docs.text: Profile Key Parameters Hash & Mode Salt / Nonce Signature Size rsa-pss-sha256 RSA 3072-bit, $e = 65537$ RSASSA-PSS with SHA-256 and MGF1(SHA-256) Salt: 32 bytes 384 bytes ecdsa-p256-sha256 NIST P-256 / secp256r1 ECDSA with SHA-256 CSPRNG or RFC 6979 64 bytes (r \|\| s) ed25519 Curve25519 PureEdDSA (RFC 8032) Standard Ed25519 64 bytes

docs.title: 1. RSA-PSS (rsa-pss-sha256)
docs.text:
• Standard: RFC 8017 (PKCS #1 v2.2).
  • Public Exponent: 65537.
  • Modulus Size: 3072 bits (128-bit cryptographic security level).
  • Padding: Probabilistic Signature Scheme (PSS) using Mask Generation Function 1 (MGF1) based on SHA-256.
  • Salt Length: Exactly 32 bytes (equal to SHA-256 output length).
  • API Mapping: 
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import padding

# Signing
signature = private_key.sign(
    manifest_bytes,
    padding.PSS(mgf=padding.MGF1(hashes.SHA256()), salt_length=32),
    hashes.SHA256(),
)

# Verification
public_key.verify(
    signature,
    manifest_bytes,
    padding.PSS(mgf=padding.MGF1(hashes.SHA256()), salt_length=32),
    hashes.SHA256(),
)

docs.title: 2. ECDSA (ecdsa-p256-sha256)
docs.text:
• Standard: FIPS 186-5, ANSI X9.62.
  • Curve: NIST P-256 (secp256r1 / prime256v1).
  • Hash: SHA-256 applied once over manifest bytes $M$.
  • Wire Format: IEEE P1363 raw concatenation r || s:
  • $r$: 32 bytes big-endian.
  • $s$: 32 bytes big-endian.
  • Total length: exactly 64 bytes.
  • ASN.1 DER Conversion: When communicating with standard cryptographic libraries (which emit or consume ASN.1 DER sequences), NoraSign extracts the raw 32-byte big-endian integers $(r, s)$ for bundle storage, and reconstructs the DER sequence upon verification.

docs.title: 3. Ed25519 (ed25519)
docs.text:
• Standard: RFC 8032.
  • Mode: PureEdDSA (Ed25519). The pre-hashed variant (Ed25519ph) is strictly prohibited.
  • Input: The raw canonical manifest byte string $M$ is passed directly to the signing function without external hashing.
  • Signature Length: 64 bytes standard Ed25519 wire format.
  • API Mapping: 
    # Direct message signing
signature = private_key.sign(manifest_bytes)

# Direct message verification
public_key.verify(signature, manifest_bytes)

docs.title: Public Key Fingerprinting (keyid)
docs.text:
To ensure deterministic, cross-platform identification of public keys regardless of PEM line-wrapping or line endings (\r\n vs \n), the keyid is computed directly over the canonical SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI) DER bytes:

$$\text{keyid} = \text{hex_lower}(\text{SHA-256}(\text{DER_SPKI}))$$

This produces a unique 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string matching ^[0-9a-f]{64}$.

docs.title: Release Manifest (minisign-manifest/v1)
docs.text: The release manifest is a canonical JSON document capturing the metadata and integrity digest of the software artifact.

docs.title: Schema Fields
docs.text: Field Type Regex / Constraints Description schema string Constant: "minisign-manifest/v1" Manifest schema identifier package string ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$ Lowercase package name version string ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,63}$ Release version algorithm string One of supported profiles Cryptographic algorithm name keyid string ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ 64-character lowercase hex public key fingerprint artifact object Exact fields: name, size, sha256 Artifact integrity descriptor artifact.name string ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ Basename of artifact file (no paths) artifact.size integer $[0, 9007199254740991]$ File size in bytes (IEEE 754 safe int) artifact.sha256 string ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 digest

docs.title: Canonical Serialization Rules
docs.text: To guarantee byte-for-byte reproducibility: 1. No UTF-8 BOM: Prohibited from starting with \xef\xbb\xbf. 2. Strict Field Sequencing: - Manifest root: schema, package, version, algorithm, keyid, artifact. - Artifact object: name, size, sha256. 3. Zero Whitespace: No spaces, tabs, or newlines outside JSON string literals (separators=(',', ':')). 4. No Trailing Newline: The byte string terminates directly at the closing }. 5. No Floats or Booleans for Size: Boolean values like true or false are strictly rejected. 6. Maximum Size: Must not exceed 16 KiB (16,384 bytes).

docs.title: Release Bundle (minisign-bundle/v1)
docs.text:
The release bundle encapsulates the canonical manifest bytes and digital signature in a portable Base64-encoded JSON structure.

{
  "schema": "minisign-bundle/v1",
  "manifest_b64": "<base64 encoded canonical manifest bytes>",
  "signature_b64": "<base64 encoded raw signature bytes>"
}

docs.title: Constraints
docs.text:
• Encoded using standard RFC 4648 Base64 with = padding.
  • Prohibits whitespace (newlines, spaces) inside Base64 strings.
  • Maximum bundle size: 64 KiB (65,536 bytes).
  • Must not contain private keys or extra fields.

docs.title: Video Demo Guide & Storyboard (Bonus 1)
docs.text: This document provides the storyboard, speaking script outline, and demonstration checklist for the <=20 minute video demo required for Bonus 1 (+5 points).

docs.title: General Requirements
docs.text:
• Platform: YouTube (must be public or unlisted with public link, uploaded to youtube.com).
  • Duration: Maximum 20 minutes.
  • Participation: All group members must speak on-camera with introductions (wajib oncam dan melakukan perkenalan).
